method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie抢在Wendy伸手去够门把手之前把门拉开
facts.anchor: She pulls the door open as Wendy is reaching out for the knob.

facts.fact: Hattie谎称家里有县审计员，以掩饰Eeling仍在场
facts.anchor: “Not company, no. Just”—the gears of her mind spin maddeningly—“a county auditor.”

facts.fact: Wendy说明困境：Kevin被困在法庭，她在图书馆的晚班因同事女儿生病请假而无人替班
facts.anchor: Kevin’s stuck in court and my evening shift at the library just called in because her daughter’s sick

facts.fact: Hattie答应照看Julian，并说他们还有拼图要完成
facts.anchor: “Of course. No problem at all. We do have a puzzle to finish, do we not?”

facts.fact: Wendy拥抱Julian并亲吻他头顶，叮嘱他完成当晚布置的阅读后赶回车里
facts.anchor: telling him to make sure he does the reading he’s been assigned for the night

facts.fact: Hattie把Julian带进屋，赶在他注意到仍坐在原位的Eeling之前把他推沿走廊送去
facts.anchor: scoots him straight down the hallway before he can pause at the sight of Eeling

facts.fact: Eeling在门廊上说今天到此为止，明天可以完成并解释一些事情，之后不再打扰
facts.anchor: “I think we can finish tomorrow. And I’ll be able to explain some things then.

facts.fact: Eeling指出Hattie不单是想靠近那个孩子，而是在监视他
facts.anchor: “It’s not just wanting to be close to him, is it? You’re watching him.”

facts.fact: Eeling离开后Julian打开房门出现在走廊尽头，Hattie提议去做可可
facts.anchor: Julian’s door opens and the boy himself appears at the head of the hallway.
